//ClientIds: The client IDs this API pins in its authorization rules. Each must equal the same key under ClientIds in src/IDP/appsettings.json (where the IDP registers the client); a missing one stops the start-up.
//Mfa: Step-up: officer decisions need a sign-in with the authenticator code while true. Keep it equal to the IDP's Mfa:Enabled.

Mfa.//StepUpMaxAgeMinutes: While MFA is on, a decision needs a sign-in with the authenticator code at most this many minutes old (1-60).

//ConnectionStrings: KycDbConnection holds a password, so it is NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads it from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__KycDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the API refuses to start.
